note: 情景对话库。每个场景给 AI 一个明确的角色和目标，把"随便聊"变成"有目标的练习"。level 决定它出现在哪个水平的每日计划里；goal 是这次练习要达成的事，AI 会围着它推进对话。category 同时也是地图上的章节，章节顺序见 SCENE_CHAPTERS（public/js/app.js）。注意：id 是用户通关记录的主键，一旦发布就不要再改。

scenarios.title: 开学第一天认识同学
scenarios.brief: 介绍自己、问对方专业，把话接下去
scenarios.aiRole: 一位同班的美国同学，性格随和爱聊
scenarios.setting: 开学第一天，学生在教室里坐到一位同学旁边
scenarios.goal: 让学生完成自我介绍、问出对方的专业和年级，并至少延伸一个共同话题
scenarios.opener: Hey! Is this seat taken? I'm Alex — first year here. You?
keyPhrases: How do you like it so far?

scenarios.title: 图书馆借书与续借
scenarios.aiRole: 一位耐心的图书馆管理员
scenarios.setting: 学生在大学图书馆前台，想借一本指定教材
scenarios.goal: 让学生借到书，并问清借期和怎么续借
scenarios.opener: Hi, how can I help you today?

scenarios.title: 和室友第一次相处
scenarios.aiRole: 一位刚搬进来的室友，随和但有自己的习惯
scenarios.setting: 学生和新室友第一次坐下来聊住在一起的规矩
scenarios.goal: 让学生说出自己的作息习惯，并和对方约定一条家务分工
scenarios.opener: So... should we talk about house rules or is that too formal?
keyPhrases: I usually go to bed around...

scenarios.title: 选课与注册
scenarios.brief: 问课程时间、学分、能不能加进去
scenarios.aiRole: 一位学院的教务老师
scenarios.setting: 学生想选一门已经满员的课，去教务办公室问办法
scenarios.goal: 让学生问清课程时间和学分，并问出候补名单怎么排
scenarios.opener: Hi, what can I help you with today?
keyPhrases: Can I get on the waitlist?

scenarios.title: 在校园里迷路
scenarios.brief: 问教学楼怎么走、要走多久
scenarios.aiRole: 一位正好路过的学长
scenarios.setting: 学生第一周找不到上课的教学楼，拦住一个人问路
scenarios.goal: 让学生说清要去哪，听懂路线后复述一遍确认
scenarios.opener: You look a little lost — need help finding something?

scenarios.title: 参加社团招新
scenarios.brief: 问活动内容、时间、怎么加入
scenarios.aiRole: 一位社团招新摊位上的热情学生
scenarios.setting: 学生在社团招新日走到一个感兴趣的摊位前
scenarios.goal: 让学生问出活动频率和加入方式，并留下联系方式
scenarios.opener: Hey! Want to hear about what we do?
keyPhrases: What kind of things do you do?

scenarios.title: 去 office hour 问问题
scenarios.brief: 讲清楚哪里没懂，并请老师再解释一遍
scenarios.aiRole: 一位友善但时间紧的大学教授
scenarios.setting: 学生在教授的 office hour 敲门进来，带着上节课的疑问
scenarios.goal: 让学生说清楚具体卡在哪一步，听懂解释后用自己的话复述一遍
scenarios.opener: Come on in. You had a question about last week’s lecture?
keyPhrases: Could you go over that again?

scenarios.title: 小组作业分工
scenarios.brief: 提出想法、分配任务、约下次时间
scenarios.aiRole: 一位同组的同学，有自己的想法但愿意商量
scenarios.setting: 学生和同组同学第一次碰头，讨论一份要交的小组报告
scenarios.goal: 让学生提出一个分工方案，回应对方的不同意见，并约定下次见面时间
scenarios.opener: So... we should probably figure out who’s doing what. Any thoughts?

scenarios.title: 课堂展示后答疑
scenarios.brief: 回应同学和老师的提问
scenarios.aiRole: 一位追问细节的同学，之后是教授
scenarios.setting: 学生刚讲完一个课堂 presentation，进入提问环节
scenarios.goal: 让学生听懂问题、给出有依据的回答，并承认一处自己没把握的地方
scenarios.opener: Thanks for the presentation. I have a question about your second point.
keyPhrases: Let me come back to you on that

scenarios.title: 申请作业延期
scenarios.aiRole: 一位讲原则但通情达理的教授
scenarios.setting: 学生因为生病没能按时完成论文，去找教授申请延期
scenarios.goal: 让学生说明情况、主动提出一个具体的新期限，并接受可能的扣分
scenarios.opener: Come in. You wanted to talk about the paper deadline?
keyPhrases: I can have it to you by...
I understand if that affects my grade

scenarios.title: 和导师谈选专业
scenarios.brief: 讲清兴趣和顾虑，听取建议
scenarios.aiRole: 一位学术导师，会反问学生真实想法
scenarios.setting: 学生在两个专业之间犹豫，约了导师谈话
scenarios.goal: 让学生讲清两个选项的吸引力和顾虑，并回应导师的反问
scenarios.opener: So you're thinking about switching. Tell me what's going on.
keyPhrases: Do you think it's realistic to...?

scenarios.title: 组织期末复习小组
scenarios.brief: 召集人、定时间地点、分配范围
scenarios.aiRole: 一位愿意参加但时间很紧的同学
scenarios.setting: 期末将至，学生想拉几个人一起复习
scenarios.goal: 让学生说服对方参加，并敲定一个双方都能来的时间
scenarios.opener: I'd love to, but my schedule is kind of a mess right now.
keyPhrases: It doesn't have to be long

scenarios.title: 问教授要推荐信
scenarios.brief: 说明用途、提供材料、表达感谢
scenarios.aiRole: 一位愿意帮忙但需要信息的教授
scenarios.setting: 学生申请实习需要一封推荐信，来找上过课的教授
scenarios.goal: 让学生说清申请的岗位和截止日期，并主动提出提供简历
scenarios.opener: Sure, I can write one. What's it for?
keyPhrases: I can send you my resume

scenarios.title: 小组里有人不干活
scenarios.brief: 把问题摆到桌面上又不撕破脸
scenarios.aiRole: 一位一直没交自己那部分的组员，起初回避
scenarios.setting: 小组作业快截止，有个组员始终没交东西
scenarios.goal: 让学生指出具体问题、听对方解释，并提出一个可执行的补救方案
scenarios.opener: Hey, sorry — I know I'm behind. Things have been crazy.
keyPhrases: I wanted to check in about...
Can we agree on a deadline?

scenarios.title: 为分数申诉
scenarios.aiRole: 一位不轻易改分、要求学生给出依据的教授
scenarios.setting: 学生认为一份作业被打低了，去找教授理论
scenarios.goal: 让学生指出具体的评分点、拿出依据，并接受一个不完全满意的结果
scenarios.opener: I'm happy to go through it, but I stand by the grade unless there's an error.
keyPhrases: Could you take another look at...?

scenarios.title: 和邻居打招呼
scenarios.aiRole: 一位友善的邻居，喜欢聊几句
scenarios.setting: 学生刚搬进公寓，在楼道里遇到邻居
scenarios.goal: 让学生完成自我介绍，并至少延伸一个话题（天气、附近、宠物）
scenarios.opener: Morning! You just moved in, right?
keyPhrases: How long have you lived here?

scenarios.title: 取快递和包裹
scenarios.brief: 报姓名、出示证件、处理丢件
scenarios.aiRole: 一位快递点的工作人员
scenarios.setting: 学生去取一个显示已送达但没收到的包裹
scenarios.goal: 让学生说清包裹信息，并在被告知查不到时提出下一步怎么办
scenarios.opener: Hi, do you have a tracking number?
keyPhrases: What should I do if it's lost?

scenarios.title: 理发店剪头发
scenarios.brief: 说清想要的长度和样式
scenarios.aiRole: 一位健谈的理发师
scenarios.setting: 学生第一次在美国理发店剪头发
scenarios.goal: 让学生说清想剪多短、哪里不要动，并在中途叫停调整
scenarios.opener: So, what are we doing today?
keyPhrases: Can you leave the top longer?

scenarios.title: 公共洗衣房
scenarios.brief: 问怎么用机器、怎么付钱
scenarios.aiRole: 一位正在洗衣服的住户
scenarios.setting: 学生第一次用公寓的公共洗衣房，不会操作
scenarios.goal: 让学生问出机器怎么启动、怎么付费、洗一次要多久
scenarios.opener: Need a hand? These machines are kind of weird.
keyPhrases: Does it take coins or card?

scenarios.title: 聊天气和周末
scenarios.aiRole: 一位在等电梯的同楼住户
scenarios.setting: 学生和陌生人一起等电梯，尴尬的三十秒
scenarios.goal: 让学生主动开启话题并自然地收尾
scenarios.opener: Crazy weather today, huh?

scenarios.title: 办手机卡
scenarios.brief: 问套餐、流量、能不能月付
scenarios.aiRole: 一位营业厅店员
scenarios.setting: 学生刚到美国，要办一张手机卡
scenarios.goal: 让学生问出月费、流量额度，并说出自己选哪个套餐
scenarios.opener: Hi there, looking for a new plan?
keyPhrases: How much data do I get?

scenarios.title: 健身房办卡
scenarios.brief: 问价格、器材、能不能先试
scenarios.aiRole: 一位健身房的销售
scenarios.setting: 学生想在附近健身房办一张卡
scenarios.goal: 让学生问出月费和有没有合约，并要求先试用一次
scenarios.opener: Welcome in! Want a quick tour?
keyPhrases: How much is the monthly fee?

scenarios.title: 丢了东西去失物招领
scenarios.brief: 描述物品特征、留联系方式
scenarios.aiRole: 一位需要核实细节的失物招领员
scenarios.setting: 学生把背包落在了图书馆，去失物招领处找
scenarios.goal: 让学生详细描述物品特征，并在被要求时提供可验证的细节
scenarios.opener: Can you describe it for me?
keyPhrases: There's a sticker on the front

scenarios.title: 叫人来修东西
scenarios.aiRole: 一位维修公司的调度员
scenarios.setting: 学生家里的暖气坏了，打电话叫维修
scenarios.goal: 让学生说清故障现象、地址，并敲定一个上门时间段
scenarios.opener: Maintenance, how can I help?

scenarios.title: 打电话改预约
scenarios.aiRole: 一位电话另一端的前台
scenarios.setting: 学生要把一个已约好的预约改到下周
scenarios.goal: 让学生报出原预约信息、提出新时间，并确认改成功了
scenarios.opener: Thanks for calling. How can I help you?
keyPhrases: Do you have anything next week?

scenarios.title: 把闲聊聊深一点
scenarios.aiRole: 一位刚认识、话不多但愿意聊的人
scenarios.setting: 学生在一个活动上和人聊了两句，想把话题聊开
scenarios.goal: 让学生找到一个共同点并把对话延续三轮以上
scenarios.opener: Yeah, it's been a long week.
keyPhrases: What do you do for fun?
How did you get into that?

scenarios.title: 请人帮个忙
scenarios.brief: 开口求助、说明原因、表达感谢
scenarios.aiRole: 一位不太熟但人不错的同事/同学
scenarios.setting: 学生需要请人帮忙照看一下东西/代收包裹
scenarios.goal: 让学生礼貌地开口、说明原因，并在对方犹豫时给出替代方案
scenarios.opener: Sure, what's up?
keyPhrases: I was wondering if you could...
It would only take a minute

scenarios.title: 为迟到或失约道歉
scenarios.aiRole: 一位等了很久、有点不高兴的朋友
scenarios.setting: 学生迟到了四十分钟，对方已经等很久了
scenarios.goal: 让学生真诚道歉、简短解释而不找借口，并提出补救
scenarios.opener: I was starting to think you forgot.
keyPhrases: Let me make it up to you

scenarios.title: 委婉地拒绝邀请
scenarios.aiRole: 一位热情邀请、会再劝一次的朋友
scenarios.setting: 朋友邀请学生参加一个他不想去的活动
scenarios.goal: 让学生礼貌拒绝、在被再次邀请时坚持立场，并提出别的安排
scenarios.opener: Come on, it'll be fun! Just for an hour?
keyPhrases: I've got a lot on right now

scenarios.title: 紧急情况打电话求助
scenarios.aiRole: 一位冷静提问的接线员
scenarios.setting: 学生目击了一起事故，打电话报警
scenarios.goal: 让学生说清位置、情况和人数，并按对方指示保持在线
scenarios.opener: 911, what's your emergency?

scenarios.title: 服装店试衣
scenarios.brief: 问尺码、试穿、说出哪里不合适

scenarios.setting: 学生在一家美式服装店看中一件外套，想试穿
scenarios.goal: 让学生问到尺码、要求试穿，并说清楚哪里不合身
scenarios.opener: Hi there! Let me know if you need a different size.
keyPhrases: Do you have this in a medium?

scenarios.title: 超市找东西和结账
scenarios.brief: 问商品在哪、称重、结账付款
scenarios.aiRole: 一位超市店员，后来是收银员
scenarios.setting: 学生在美国超市找不到要买的东西，之后去结账
scenarios.goal: 让学生问到商品位置，并在收银台完成一次付款对话
scenarios.opener: Hi, are you finding everything okay?

scenarios.title: 买鞋问尺码
scenarios.aiRole: 一位鞋店店员
scenarios.setting: 学生想买一双跑鞋，不确定美码尺寸
scenarios.goal: 让学生问出对应尺码、试穿并说出哪里不舒服
scenarios.opener: What size are you looking for?
keyPhrases: Can I try the next size up?

scenarios.title: 网购客服在线咨询
scenarios.aiRole: 一位在线客服
scenarios.setting: 学生的网购订单一周没动静，找在线客服
scenarios.goal: 让学生提供订单号、问出物流状态，并要求更新地址
scenarios.opener: Hi! Could I have your order number?

scenarios.title: 药店买非处方药
scenarios.aiRole: 一位药店的店员
scenarios.setting: 学生感冒了，去药店买药
scenarios.goal: 让学生描述症状、问出用量和注意事项
scenarios.opener: Hi, can I help you find something?
keyPhrases: How often should I take it?

scenarios.title: 逛农夫市集
scenarios.brief: 问价格、挑选、砍一点点价
scenarios.aiRole: 一位摊主，人很好但不太肯降价
scenarios.setting: 学生周末逛农夫市集买菜
scenarios.goal: 让学生问价、挑选，并尝试买多一点换个优惠价
scenarios.opener: Morning! Everything's picked fresh this week.
keyPhrases: If I take two, can you do...?

scenarios.title: 退货和换货
scenarios.brief: 说明原因、出示小票、争取退款
scenarios.aiRole: 一位按规定办事的客服，需要被说服
scenarios.setting: 学生买的东西有瑕疵，拿回店里要求退款，但已经过了7天
scenarios.goal: 让学生说清问题、提出诉求，并在被拒绝一次后换一种说法争取到换货
scenarios.opener: Hi, what can I do for you today?
keyPhrases: It stopped working after two days
I have the receipt right here
Is there anything you can do?

scenarios.title: 问折扣和比价
scenarios.brief: 问有没有优惠、比较两件商品
scenarios.aiRole: 一位电子产品店员，懂行也会推销
scenarios.setting: 学生想买一台笔记本，在两个型号之间犹豫，还想问有没有学生折扣
scenarios.goal: 让学生问出两个型号的差别，问到学生折扣，并说出自己的决定和理由
scenarios.opener: Looking for something specific, or just browsing?
keyPhrases: What’s the difference between these two?
Does it come with a warranty?

scenarios.title: 买电子产品问参数
scenarios.aiRole: 一位懂行的电子产品店员
scenarios.setting: 学生想买一个耳机，纠结两款
scenarios.goal: 让学生问出两款的差别、保修政策，并说明自己的选择理由
scenarios.opener: Are you looking for noise-canceling or just regular?

scenarios.title: 保修期内维修
scenarios.brief: 说明故障、争取免费维修
scenarios.aiRole: 一位按流程办事的售后人员
scenarios.setting: 学生买的设备在保修期内坏了，去要求维修
scenarios.goal: 让学生说清购买时间和故障，并在被告知要收费时据理力争
scenarios.opener: Do you have proof of purchase?
keyPhrases: I bought it four months ago
It should still be under warranty
It stopped working on its own
Can you check the policy again?

scenarios.title: 收到错的商品
scenarios.aiRole: 一位客服，会先要求提供照片
scenarios.setting: 学生收到的商品和下单的不一样
scenarios.goal: 让学生说清问题、按要求提供证据，并争取到补寄而不是退款
scenarios.opener: I'm sorry about that. Can you send a photo?
keyPhrases: I'd rather have the right one

scenarios.title: 取消订阅服务
scenarios.aiRole: 一位会挽留三次的客服
scenarios.setting: 学生想取消一个按月扣费的订阅
scenarios.goal: 让学生明确提出取消、拒绝优惠挽留，并确认取消成功和最后扣费日期

keyPhrases: Please go ahead and cancel it
Can you confirm that in an email?

scenarios.title: 要求价格匹配

scenarios.setting: 学生发现同款商品别家更便宜，要求价格匹配
scenarios.goal: 让学生出示证据、说清诉求，并在被拒一次后换个说法争取
scenarios.opener: Let me take a look at that. Is it the same model?
keyPhrases: Is there anything you can do?

scenarios.title: 挑礼物请人推荐
scenarios.aiRole: 一位很会推荐的店员
scenarios.setting: 学生要给朋友挑生日礼物，没有头绪
scenarios.goal: 让学生说清送礼对象、预算和场合，并在推荐中做出选择
scenarios.opener: Who's it for, and what's your budget?

scenarios.title: 投诉服务态度
scenarios.aiRole: 一位一开始推卸责任的经理
scenarios.setting: 学生在店里受到很差的服务，要求见经理
scenarios.goal: 让学生冷静陈述事实、明确提出诉求，并在被敷衍后升级要求

keyPhrases: I'd like to explain what happened
That's not what I was told
Who else can I speak to?

scenarios.title: 在咖啡店点单
scenarios.brief: 点一杯咖啡，说清楚规格和口味
scenarios.aiRole: 一位友好的咖啡店店员
scenarios.setting: 学生走进一家美式咖啡店，店里有点忙
scenarios.goal: 让学生成功点到一杯饮品，并回答尺寸、冷热、是否加糖奶这几个追问

scenarios.aiRole: 一位专业的餐厅服务员
scenarios.setting: 一家中档西餐厅的晚餐时段
scenarios.goal: 让学生点完一份主菜和一杯饮料，并提出一个要求（比如不要洋葱）
scenarios.opener: Good evening! Have you had a chance to look at the menu?

scenarios.title: 打电话订位
scenarios.aiRole: 一位餐厅接线员
scenarios.setting: 学生要为周五晚上订一张四人桌
scenarios.goal: 让学生报清人数时间，并提出一个特殊要求（靠窗/过敏）
scenarios.opener: Thanks for calling. How many in your party?
keyPhrases: Do you have anything by the window?

scenarios.title: 快餐店点餐
scenarios.aiRole: 一位语速很快的快餐店员
scenarios.setting: 学生在快餐店柜台点餐，队伍很长
scenarios.goal: 让学生完成点单、听懂追问并回答，最后确认总价
scenarios.opener: Hi, welcome in — what can I get for you?
keyPhrases: Can I get that without onions?

scenarios.title: 说明食物过敏

scenarios.setting: 学生对坚果过敏，点菜前要问清楚
scenarios.goal: 让学生说明过敏、要求确认厨房做法，并得到明确答复
scenarios.opener: Any allergies I should know about?
keyPhrases: Is there any in the sauce?
Could you check with the kitchen?

scenarios.title: 上错菜了
scenarios.aiRole: 一位道歉并想办法补救的服务员
scenarios.setting: 学生点的菜上错了，而且已经等了很久
scenarios.goal: 让学生礼貌指出问题、要求换菜，并询问要等多久
scenarios.opener: Here you go — the grilled chicken.
keyPhrases: I think there's been a mix-up

scenarios.title: 买单和分账
scenarios.aiRole: 一位服务员
scenarios.setting: 学生和朋友吃完饭要分开付账
scenarios.goal: 让学生要到账单、说明怎么分账，并处理小费
scenarios.opener: Can I get you anything else?

scenarios.title: 点一杯复杂的咖啡
scenarios.aiRole: 一位连锁咖啡店的店员
scenarios.setting: 学生想点一杯定制的咖啡饮品
scenarios.goal: 让学生完整说出尺寸、奶类、甜度和冷热，并报出名字
scenarios.opener: What can I get started for you?

scenarios.title: 电话点外卖
scenarios.brief: 点单、报地址、问送达时间
scenarios.aiRole: 一位电话点单的餐厅员工
scenarios.setting: 学生打电话订外卖送到家
scenarios.goal: 让学生完成点单、报清地址电话，并问出预计送达时间
scenarios.opener: Pickup or delivery?
keyPhrases: Can I pay by card over the phone?

scenarios.title: 请服务员推荐菜
scenarios.aiRole: 一位很懂菜单的服务员
scenarios.setting: 学生第一次来一家餐厅，看不懂菜单
scenarios.goal: 让学生说出偏好和忌口，问清推荐菜的做法，并做出选择
scenarios.opener: First time here? I'm happy to walk you through it.
keyPhrases: That sounds good, I'll try it

scenarios.title: 菜品有问题
scenarios.aiRole: 一位一开始有点防备的经理
scenarios.setting: 学生的菜没熟/太咸，叫来了经理
scenarios.goal: 让学生具体描述问题、提出诉求，并接受一个合理的解决方案
scenarios.opener: Is there something wrong with the dish?
keyPhrases: Could you take it off the bill?
Thank you for sorting that out

scenarios.title: 在聚餐上解释饮食习惯
scenarios.brief: 说明自己不吃什么又不扫兴
scenarios.aiRole: 一位热情劝菜的主人
scenarios.setting: 学生在朋友家做客，主人一直劝他吃不能吃的东西
scenarios.goal: 让学生礼貌说明、婉拒劝菜，并主动称赞别的菜
scenarios.opener: Come on, just a little bite!
keyPhrases: Could I get more of that instead?

scenarios.title: 和朋友一起做饭
scenarios.aiRole: 一位在厨房里指挥的朋友
scenarios.setting: 学生和朋友一起在厨房做一顿饭
scenarios.goal: 让学生问清步骤、主动认领一项任务，并处理一个小失误
scenarios.opener: Can you start on the vegetables while I do this?
keyPhrases: How fine should I chop these?
I think I burned it a little

scenarios.title: 在酒吧点单和搭话
scenarios.aiRole: 一位忙碌但友好的酒保
scenarios.setting: 学生在酒吧点酒，顺便和旁边的人搭话
scenarios.goal: 让学生完成点单，并和旁边的人开启一段简短对话
scenarios.opener: What'll it be?
keyPhrases: What do you have on tap?

scenarios.title: 和店家谈差评
scenarios.brief: 说明不满、听对方解释、决定怎么办
scenarios.aiRole: 一位主动联系你的店主，态度诚恳
scenarios.setting: 学生写了差评，店主打电话来沟通
scenarios.goal: 让学生说清问题、听完解释，并给出是否修改评价的明确回应
scenarios.opener: I saw your review and I wanted to reach out personally.

scenarios.title: 在街上问路
scenarios.brief: 问怎么去地铁站，并听懂对方的指路
scenarios.aiRole: 一位热心的本地路人
scenarios.setting: 学生在一条陌生的街上，想找最近的地铁站
scenarios.goal: 让学生问清方向，并能复述一遍确认自己听懂了
scenarios.opener: You look a little lost — do you need help finding something?
keyPhrases: Excuse me, how do I get to...

scenarios.title: 坐公交问路线
scenarios.brief: 问几路车、在哪下、要多久
scenarios.aiRole: 一位公交司机，说话简短
scenarios.setting: 学生要坐公交去一个地方，不确定哪一路
scenarios.goal: 让学生问出车次、下车站点和大概时间
scenarios.opener: Where you headed?
keyPhrases: Which stop should I get off?

scenarios.title: 地铁买票和换乘
scenarios.aiRole: 一位地铁站的工作人员
scenarios.setting: 学生第一次坐地铁，不会买票也不知道怎么换乘
scenarios.goal: 让学生买到票，并问清在哪换乘、往哪个方向
scenarios.opener: Need help with the machine?
keyPhrases: How much is a single ride?

scenarios.title: 打车说目的地
scenarios.aiRole: 一位话不多的出租车司机
scenarios.setting: 学生打车去机场
scenarios.goal: 让学生说清目的地、确认大致价格，并在下车时要收据
scenarios.opener: Where to?
keyPhrases: About how much will it be?

scenarios.title: 网约车找车和沟通
scenarios.aiRole: 一位打电话来确认位置的司机
scenarios.setting: 学生叫了网约车但司机找不到人
scenarios.goal: 让学生说清自己的位置特征，并约定一个好找的上车点
scenarios.opener: Hi, I'm here but I don't see you.

scenarios.title: 加油站加油
scenarios.aiRole: 一位加油站店员
scenarios.setting: 学生第一次在美国自助加油站加油
scenarios.goal: 让学生问清付款流程和油号选择
scenarios.opener: Pump number?

scenarios.title: 机场值机与安检
scenarios.brief: 办登机牌、托运行李、应对追问
scenarios.aiRole: 一位效率很高的地勤人员
scenarios.setting: 学生在国际航班的值机柜台，带一件托运行李
scenarios.goal: 让学生完成值机，并处理一个意外（行李超重）
scenarios.opener: Good morning. May I see your passport and booking reference, please?
keyPhrases: Is there a window seat available?
How much is the excess baggage fee?

scenarios.title: 航班延误改签
scenarios.brief: 问原因、要求改签或补偿
scenarios.aiRole: 一位应对很多投诉的地勤
scenarios.setting: 学生的航班延误了四小时，会赶不上转机
scenarios.goal: 让学生说清转机风险、要求改签，并争取到餐食券或住宿
scenarios.opener: I'm afraid the delay is weather-related.

scenarios.title: 火车买票和座位
scenarios.aiRole: 一位火车站售票员
scenarios.setting: 学生要买一张周末的火车票
scenarios.goal: 让学生问出班次和价格，选定座位类型并完成购票
scenarios.opener: Where and when are you traveling?

scenarios.title: 被查票没票
scenarios.aiRole: 一位按规矩办事的查票员
scenarios.setting: 学生上车忘了买票，被查到了
scenarios.goal: 让学生诚实说明、接受后果，并问清怎么缴罚款
scenarios.opener: Ticket, please. ... You don't have one?
keyPhrases: I didn't realize I had to
How do I pay the fine?

scenarios.title: 租车
scenarios.aiRole: 一位会推销附加服务的租车员
scenarios.setting: 学生在机场租一辆车
scenarios.goal: 让学生问清保险和油费政策，拒绝不需要的附加项，并确认还车时间
scenarios.opener: Would you like to add full coverage?
keyPhrases: What does the basic insurance cover?
Do I need to return it full?
What time do I bring it back?

scenarios.title: 问开车路线
scenarios.aiRole: 一位好心但说得很快的当地人
scenarios.setting: 学生开车迷路，停下来问路
scenarios.goal: 让学生听懂路线、复述确认，并问清有没有更好走的路
scenarios.opener: Okay so you're gonna wanna take the second left...
keyPhrases: So I go straight and then...?

scenarios.title: 发生小刮蹭
scenarios.aiRole: 一位情绪有点激动的对方司机
scenarios.setting: 学生开车时和别人发生轻微剐蹭
scenarios.goal: 让学生保持冷静、交换保险信息，并避免在现场承担责任
scenarios.opener: You came out of nowhere! Look at my bumper.
keyPhrases: I'd rather let the insurance decide

scenarios.title: 被交警拦下
scenarios.aiRole: 一位公事公办的交警
scenarios.setting: 学生开车超速被拦下
scenarios.goal: 让学生礼貌配合、出示证件，并在被开罚单后问清怎么处理
scenarios.opener: Do you know why I pulled you over?
keyPhrases: I wasn't aware of the limit
How do I take care of this?

scenarios.title: 行李丢了
scenarios.brief: 描述行李、要求赔偿和补给
scenarios.aiRole: 一位流程化应对的航空公司员工
scenarios.setting: 学生落地后行李没出来
scenarios.goal: 让学生完成挂失登记、问出赔偿政策，并争取到应急生活费
scenarios.opener: Let's file a report. Can you describe the bag?
keyPhrases: I have nothing but what I'm wearing

scenarios.title: 打电话订房
scenarios.aiRole: 一位酒店前台
scenarios.setting: 学生要订一间下周的房间
scenarios.goal: 让学生问出房型价格、是否含早餐，并完成预订
scenarios.opener: Thanks for calling. How can I help?
keyPhrases: Do you have any rooms available?

scenarios.title: 退房
scenarios.aiRole: 一位酒店前台
scenarios.setting: 学生退房但航班在晚上
scenarios.goal: 让学生完成退房、要求寄存行李，并请前台叫车
scenarios.opener: Checking out? How was your stay?
keyPhrases: Can I leave my bags here?
What time do I need to be out?
Could you call me a taxi?

scenarios.title: 房间有问题
scenarios.aiRole: 一位客房服务人员
scenarios.setting: 学生房间的空调坏了，很闷热
scenarios.goal: 让学生说清问题、要求处理，并在修不好时提出换房
scenarios.opener: Front desk, how can I help?

scenarios.title: 和房东沟通入住
scenarios.aiRole: 一位热心的 Airbnb 房东
scenarios.setting: 学生入住短租房，需要问一些基本信息
scenarios.goal: 让学生问出进门方式、Wi-Fi 密码和退房时间
scenarios.opener: Hi! Let me know when you get there.
keyPhrases: When do I need to check out?

scenarios.title: 参加一日游
scenarios.brief: 问行程、时间、包不包午饭
scenarios.aiRole: 一位导游
scenarios.setting: 学生想报一个当地的一日游
scenarios.goal: 让学生问清行程时长、包含内容和集合地点
scenarios.opener: Are you joining us today?

scenarios.title: 买门票和问展览
scenarios.brief: 问票价、学生票、开放时间
scenarios.aiRole: 一位博物馆售票员
scenarios.setting: 学生要买博物馆门票
scenarios.goal: 让学生问出学生票价、闭馆时间，并问一个展览的位置
scenarios.opener: One adult?
keyPhrases: Do you have a student discount?

scenarios.title: 请陌生人帮忙拍照
scenarios.aiRole: 一位愿意帮忙的游客
scenarios.setting: 学生想请路人帮自己在景点拍张照
scenarios.goal: 让学生礼貌开口、说清构图要求，并回礼帮对方拍
scenarios.opener: Sure, no problem! Like this?
keyPhrases: Would you mind taking a photo?
Could you get the building in?
Want me to take one of you?

scenarios.title: 酒店入住
scenarios.brief: 办理入住，并询问酒店设施
scenarios.aiRole: 一位酒店前台接待
scenarios.setting: 学生带着行李抵达酒店前台，已经在网上订过房
scenarios.goal: 让学生完成入住，并问清早餐时间和 WiFi 密码
scenarios.opener: Good afternoon! Checking in? Could I have your name and ID, please?
keyPhrases: Could I get a wake-up call?

scenarios.title: 和朋友商量行程
scenarios.aiRole: 一位想法不同的旅伴
scenarios.setting: 学生和朋友在规划一次旅行，两人想去的地方不同
scenarios.goal: 让学生提出方案、回应对方的不同意见，并达成一个折中安排
scenarios.opener: I was kind of hoping we'd do the beach instead.
keyPhrases: We could do that on day two

scenarios.title: 护照丢了
scenarios.aiRole: 一位领事馆的工作人员
scenarios.setting: 学生在国外丢了护照
scenarios.goal: 让学生说清情况、问出补办流程和所需材料
scenarios.opener: When did you notice it was missing?

scenarios.title: 过海关问询
scenarios.brief: 回答目的、时长、携带物品
scenarios.aiRole: 一位例行提问的海关官员
scenarios.setting: 学生入境时被海关问话
scenarios.goal: 让学生清楚回答来访目的、停留时间和住址，并如实申报物品
scenarios.opener: What's the purpose of your visit?

scenarios.title: 酒店超售没房了
scenarios.aiRole: 一位道歉但强调没办法的前台
scenarios.setting: 学生到了酒店，被告知房间超售
scenarios.goal: 让学生坚持要求安排住处，并争取到升级或交通补偿
scenarios.opener: I'm so sorry, we're fully committed tonight.
keyPhrases: What are you going to do about it?

scenarios.title: 听不懂时怎么办
scenarios.aiRole: 一位语速很快、口音重的当地人
scenarios.setting: 学生问路时完全听不懂对方在说什么
scenarios.goal: 让学生礼貌地请对方放慢或重复，最后确认自己理解对了
scenarios.opener: Yeah so it's just past the roundabout innit, can't miss it.
keyPhrases: Sorry, could you speak a bit slower?

scenarios.title: 在国外生病就医
scenarios.aiRole: 一位急诊登记处的护士
scenarios.setting: 学生在国外突然发烧，去急诊
scenarios.goal: 让学生描述症状、说明保险情况，并问清费用怎么结算
scenarios.opener: What brings you in today?
keyPhrases: I've had a fever since last night

scenarios.title: 取消行程要退款
scenarios.aiRole: 一位先搬出政策的旅行社客服
scenarios.setting: 学生因故要取消已付款的行程，对方说不能退
scenarios.goal: 让学生援引取消政策、坚持诉求，并在被拒后提出升级处理
scenarios.opener: Our policy says bookings are non-refundable.
keyPhrases: Could you check the terms again?
I'd like to speak to a supervisor
What's the best you can do?

scenarios.title: 第一次见面自我介绍
scenarios.brief: 介绍自己的名字、来处和职业
scenarios.aiRole: 一位刚认识的同龄朋友
scenarios.setting: 在一个语言交换活动上，两人刚坐到同一桌
scenarios.goal: 让学生完整介绍自己，并至少反问对方一个问题
scenarios.opener: Hey, I don't think we've met! I'm Alex. What's your name?

scenarios.title: 到派对上破冰
scenarios.aiRole: 一位派对上认识的人，友好
scenarios.setting: 学生到朋友的派对上，只认识主人
scenarios.goal: 让学生完成自我介绍并把对话延续到第三轮
scenarios.opener: Hey, I don't think we've met. I'm Sam.
keyPhrases: How do you two know each other?

scenarios.title: 要联系方式
scenarios.aiRole: 一位聊得挺好的新朋友
scenarios.setting: 学生和新认识的人聊得不错，想留个联系方式
scenarios.goal: 让学生自然地提出交换联系方式并约一个后续
scenarios.opener: Yeah, that was a fun conversation.

scenarios.title: 称赞和回应称赞
scenarios.aiRole: 一位会回夸你的朋友
scenarios.setting: 学生想称赞朋友的新造型/新成就
scenarios.goal: 让学生给出具体的称赞，并得体地接住对方的回夸

keyPhrases: That's so nice of you to say

scenarios.title: 邀请别人
scenarios.aiRole: 一位有兴趣但要确认时间的朋友
scenarios.setting: 学生想邀请朋友周末一起去做点什么
scenarios.goal: 让学生发出邀请、说清时间地点，并在对方犹豫时给出灵活方案
scenarios.opener: Maybe — what time were you thinking?

scenarios.title: 和久未联系的朋友叙旧
scenarios.aiRole: 一位很久没见的老朋友
scenarios.setting: 学生和半年没联系的朋友打电话
scenarios.goal: 让学生问出对方的近况、分享自己的变化，并约一次见面
scenarios.opener: It's been forever! How have you been?

scenarios.title: 安慰难过的人
scenarios.aiRole: 一位刚经历挫折、情绪低落的朋友
scenarios.setting: 朋友刚失去了工作/宠物，心情很差
scenarios.goal: 让学生表达关心、避免说教，并提出具体的帮助

keyPhrases: Do you want to talk about it?
I'm here if you need anything

scenarios.title: 和朋友意见不合

scenarios.setting: 朋友说了一个学生不认同的看法
scenarios.goal: 让学生礼貌地表达不同意见、给出理由，并让对话平和收尾

keyPhrases: I see it a bit differently

scenarios.title: 设定界限
scenarios.aiRole: 一位反复要求帮忙的熟人
scenarios.setting: 有人一再借钱/占用学生的时间
scenarios.goal: 让学生明确拒绝、说明原因，并在被追问时坚持立场

keyPhrases: I've helped out a few times now
I need to say no this time

scenarios.title: 行业活动上社交

scenarios.aiRole: 一位业内前辈，时间有限
scenarios.setting: 学生在行业活动上想认识一位前辈
scenarios.goal: 让学生做一个简短有力的自我介绍、问出一个有价值的问题，并请求后续联系
scenarios.opener: So what brings you to this event?
keyPhrases: What would you tell someone starting out?
Could I connect with you on LinkedIn?

scenarios.title: 在家招待客人
scenarios.aiRole: 一位第一次来家里的客人
scenarios.setting: 学生第一次在自己家招待朋友
scenarios.goal: 让学生完成迎客、招呼饮食，并自然地引导话题
scenarios.opener: Wow, your place is nice!
keyPhrases: Can I get you something to drink?

scenarios.title: 送礼和收礼
scenarios.aiRole: 一位带了礼物来的朋友
scenarios.setting: 朋友来做客带了礼物，学生也准备了一份
scenarios.goal: 让学生得体地收礼致谢、并在送出时说明心意
scenarios.opener: It's nothing much, I just saw it and thought of you.

scenarios.title: 礼貌地结束对话
scenarios.aiRole: 一位聊起来停不下来的人
scenarios.setting: 学生在活动上被一个人拉着聊了很久，想脱身
scenarios.goal: 让学生找到自然的收尾方式，礼貌离开而不失礼
scenarios.opener: Oh and another thing —
keyPhrases: It's been great talking to you
I should probably go say hi to...
Enjoy the rest of your evening

scenarios.title: 和朋友吵架后和解
scenarios.brief: 承认问题、表达感受、修复
scenarios.aiRole: 一位还有点生气但愿意谈的朋友
scenarios.setting: 学生和朋友上周吵了一架，现在想和好
scenarios.goal: 让学生主动开口、承认自己的部分、听对方说完，并提出怎么往前走
scenarios.opener: I'm still kind of upset about what you said.
keyPhrases: I'd like to understand your side
Where do we go from here?

scenarios.title: 解释文化差异
scenarios.brief: 讲清自己的文化又不说教
scenarios.aiRole: 一位好奇但带点刻板印象的外国朋友
scenarios.setting: 有人对学生的文化提出了一个带偏见的问题
scenarios.goal: 让学生冷静回应、纠正误解，并把对话引向互相了解
scenarios.opener: Is it true that everyone in China...?

scenarios.title: 预约看医生
scenarios.aiRole: 一位诊所前台
scenarios.setting: 学生要预约一次看诊
scenarios.goal: 让学生说明症状紧急程度、约到一个时间，并确认要带什么
scenarios.opener: What seems to be the problem?
keyPhrases: I'd like to make an appointment
Do you have anything this week?

scenarios.title: 取处方药
scenarios.brief: 报姓名、问用法和副作用
scenarios.aiRole: 一位药剂师
scenarios.setting: 学生去药房取医生开的处方药
scenarios.goal: 让学生取到药、问清服用方法和副作用
scenarios.opener: Have you taken this medication before?
keyPhrases: Any side effects I should know about?
Can I take it with food?

scenarios.title: 看牙医
scenarios.aiRole: 一位牙医
scenarios.setting: 学生牙疼了一周去看牙医
scenarios.goal: 让学生描述疼痛位置和程度，并问清治疗方案和费用
scenarios.opener: Where exactly does it hurt?
keyPhrases: It's this one in the back
It hurts when I drink something cold

scenarios.title: 配眼镜
scenarios.aiRole: 一位眼镜店的验光师
scenarios.setting: 学生要配一副新眼镜
scenarios.goal: 让学生完成验光沟通、说出镜框偏好，并问清取镜时间
scenarios.opener: Any changes in your vision lately?

scenarios.title: 看医生描述症状
scenarios.brief: 说清楚哪里不舒服、持续多久
scenarios.aiRole: 一位耐心的全科医生
scenarios.setting: 学生因为感冒和喉咙痛来到诊所
scenarios.goal: 让学生描述清楚症状、持续时间和严重程度，并听懂医嘱
scenarios.opener: Hi, come on in and have a seat. So, what brings you in today?
keyPhrases: I've had a sore throat for...

scenarios.title: 详细描述症状
scenarios.brief: 说清部位、持续时间、加重因素
scenarios.aiRole: 一位追问细节的医生
scenarios.setting: 学生持续头痛一个月来就诊
scenarios.goal: 让学生说清症状的部位、频率、诱因，并回答医生的追问
scenarios.opener: Tell me more about the headaches.

scenarios.title: 问医保能报多少
scenarios.aiRole: 一位保险公司客服
scenarios.setting: 学生要做一个检查，想先问清能不能报销
scenarios.goal: 让学生问出覆盖比例、自付额，并确认需不需要转诊单
scenarios.opener: Let me pull up your plan.
keyPhrases: Can you send that in writing?

scenarios.title: 想换个医生看看
scenarios.brief: 委婉提出、要求转诊和病历
scenarios.aiRole: 一位有点被冒犯的医生
scenarios.setting: 学生想找另一位医生再看看
scenarios.goal: 让学生礼貌提出、要求病历副本，并维持良好关系
scenarios.opener: Are you not satisfied with the treatment?
keyPhrases: Could I get a copy of my records?

scenarios.title: 谈心理健康
scenarios.aiRole: 一位温和的心理咨询师
scenarios.setting: 学生最近压力很大，第一次去做心理咨询
scenarios.goal: 让学生说出困扰、描述影响，并问清咨询怎么进行
scenarios.opener: What made you decide to come in?

scenarios.title: 康复训练沟通
scenarios.brief: 描述疼痛变化、问动作要领
scenarios.aiRole: 一位物理治疗师
scenarios.setting: 学生膝盖受伤，在做康复训练
scenarios.goal: 让学生反馈疼痛变化、问清动作要领，并提出一个顾虑
scenarios.opener: How did the exercises go this week?
keyPhrases: Should I push through the pain?

scenarios.title: 急诊分诊
scenarios.brief: 快速说清情况、争取优先
scenarios.aiRole: 一位忙碌的分诊护士
scenarios.setting: 学生陪朋友去急诊，情况看起来比较急
scenarios.goal: 让学生简明说清情况和病史，并在等待过久时再次沟通
scenarios.opener: Take a seat, we'll call you when we can.
keyPhrases: It started about an hour ago
Is there any way to speed this up?

scenarios.title: 听懂诊断结果
scenarios.brief: 追问专业名词、确认下一步
scenarios.aiRole: 一位说了很多术语的医生
scenarios.setting: 医生给出了一个学生听不太懂的诊断
scenarios.goal: 让学生请医生用简单话解释、确认治疗方案，并复述一遍确认理解
scenarios.opener: The imaging shows some inflammation in the joint capsule.
keyPhrases: Could you explain that in simpler terms?
What does that mean for me?
Let me make sure I understand

scenarios.title: 开银行账户
scenarios.brief: 问账户类型、手续费、所需材料
scenarios.aiRole: 一位银行柜员
scenarios.setting: 学生刚到美国要开一个银行账户
scenarios.goal: 让学生问出账户类型区别、月费和所需材料，并完成开户
scenarios.opener: Are you looking for checking or savings?
keyPhrases: What do I need to bring?

scenarios.title: 银行卡丢了
scenarios.aiRole: 一位银行客服
scenarios.setting: 学生的银行卡丢了，担心被盗刷
scenarios.goal: 让学生完成挂失、申请补卡，并查询最近的可疑交易
scenarios.opener: I can freeze the card right now. Anything look unfamiliar?
keyPhrases: There's a charge I don't recognize
Can you send a new one?

scenarios.title: 跨境汇款
scenarios.brief: 问汇率、手续费、到账时间
scenarios.aiRole: 一位银行柜员
scenarios.setting: 学生要往国内汇一笔钱
scenarios.goal: 让学生问清汇率、手续费和到账时间，并完成汇款
scenarios.opener: How much would you like to send?

scenarios.title: 争议一笔扣款
scenarios.aiRole: 一位需要走流程的银行客服
scenarios.setting: 学生账户上有一笔没授权的扣款
scenarios.goal: 让学生说清争议交易、提出退款要求，并问清调查时长
scenarios.opener: When did you first notice the charge?

scenarios.title: 咨询贷款
scenarios.aiRole: 一位贷款顾问
scenarios.setting: 学生想了解一笔小额贷款
scenarios.goal: 让学生问出利率、还款期限和申请条件，并说明自己的情况
scenarios.opener: What's the loan for?
keyPhrases: What interest rate could I get?
What do I need to qualify?
Can I pay it off early?

scenarios.title: 申请信用卡
scenarios.aiRole: 一位会推销高端卡的银行员工
scenarios.setting: 学生想申请第一张信用卡
scenarios.goal: 让学生问清年费和额度，拒绝不合适的高端卡，并选定一张
scenarios.opener: Have you considered our premium card?

scenarios.title: 问报税问题
scenarios.brief: 描述情况、问要交什么表
scenarios.aiRole: 一位报税顾问
scenarios.setting: 学生第一次在美国报税，不知道怎么办
scenarios.goal: 让学生说清自己的收入情况，问出需要哪些表格和截止日期
scenarios.opener: Are you on a student visa?
keyPhrases: This is my first time filing

scenarios.title: 办签证/居留手续
scenarios.aiRole: 一位窗口办事人员
scenarios.setting: 学生要办理居留身份的延期
scenarios.goal: 让学生问清所需材料清单、办理时长和费用
scenarios.opener: Do you have your application filled out?
keyPhrases: Can I check the status online?

scenarios.title: 考驾照和换本
scenarios.aiRole: 一位车管所窗口人员
scenarios.setting: 学生要把国内驾照换成本地驾照
scenarios.goal: 让学生问清换本流程、需要考什么，并预约一次考试
scenarios.opener: Do you have an international permit?
keyPhrases: I have a license from China
Do I need to take the test?

scenarios.title: 电话客服转接与等待
scenarios.brief: 听懂语音菜单、坚持转人工
scenarios.aiRole: 一个自动语音系统，之后是人工客服
scenarios.setting: 学生打客服电话，被自动语音绕来绕去
scenarios.goal: 让学生成功转到人工、说清问题，并在被再次转接时坚持
scenarios.opener: Please say the reason for your call.

scenarios.title: 识破电话诈骗
scenarios.aiRole: 一位自称银行安全部门的骗子
scenarios.setting: 学生接到一个自称银行的电话，要求提供验证码
scenarios.goal: 让学生拒绝提供任何敏感信息、提出主动回拨核实，并结束通话
scenarios.opener: For security, I just need the code we sent to your phone.
keyPhrases: How do I know this is really the bank?
I'll call the number on my card
I'm going to hang up now

scenarios.title: 要求免掉一笔费用
scenarios.aiRole: 一位先说"这是政策"的客服
scenarios.setting: 学生因为一次逾期被收了滞纳金，想免掉
scenarios.goal: 让学生说明自己的良好记录、明确提出诉求，并在被拒后升级
scenarios.opener: Unfortunately that fee is standard policy.
keyPhrases: I've been a customer for years
This is my first late payment
Could you waive it as a courtesy?

scenarios.title: 看房
scenarios.brief: 问租金、押金、包不包水电
scenarios.aiRole: 一位带看房的房东
scenarios.setting: 学生去看一套要租的公寓
scenarios.goal: 让学生问出租金、押金、包含费用，并提出一个顾虑
scenarios.opener: Take your time, have a look around.

scenarios.title: 提交租房申请
scenarios.brief: 问材料、信用记录、担保人
scenarios.aiRole: 一位公寓租赁办公室的职员
scenarios.setting: 学生要申请租一套公寓
scenarios.goal: 让学生问清申请材料、没有信用记录怎么办，并了解审批时长
scenarios.opener: We'll need to run a credit check.
keyPhrases: I don't have a credit history here
How long until I hear back?

scenarios.title: 报修
scenarios.aiRole: 一位反应慢的房东
scenarios.setting: 学生家的水龙头漏水两周了没人管
scenarios.goal: 让学生说清问题和已等待时间，并要求一个明确的处理时间
scenarios.opener: Yeah, I've been meaning to get to that.
keyPhrases: It's been leaking for two weeks
Could you give me a date?

scenarios.title: 开通水电网
scenarios.aiRole: 一位公用事业公司客服
scenarios.setting: 学生搬进新家要开通电和网络
scenarios.goal: 让学生完成开户、约上门时间，并问清首月费用
scenarios.opener: When would you like service to start?

scenarios.title: 看合同条款
scenarios.aiRole: 一位不太愿意改条款的房东
scenarios.setting: 学生在签租约前想问清几条条款
scenarios.goal: 让学生问清提前退租的代价、能不能转租，并争取一条修改
scenarios.opener: It's a standard lease, most people just sign it.
keyPhrases: What happens if I move out early?

scenarios.title: 和吵闹的邻居沟通

scenarios.setting: 楼上邻居每天半夜很吵
scenarios.goal: 让学生冷静提出问题、说明影响，并达成一个具体约定
scenarios.opener: It's not even that late, come on.
keyPhrases: I can hear it through the floor
I have to be up at six
Could you keep it down after eleven?
I'd rather sort this out between us

scenarios.title: 和室友算账

scenarios.goal: 让学生说清具体金额、提出还款方式，并避免撕破脸
scenarios.opener: Oh man, I totally forgot again.
keyPhrases: Could you send it this week?

scenarios.title: 要回押金

scenarios.setting: 学生退租后房东要扣一部分押金
scenarios.goal: 让学生指出争议项、拿出证据，并争取到大部分押金

keyPhrases: That was there when I moved in
I have photos from move-in day
Normal wear and tear isn't deductible

scenarios.title: 通知退租
scenarios.brief: 按合同提前通知、约验房
scenarios.aiRole: 一位按流程办事的房东
scenarios.setting: 学生要在两个月后退租
scenarios.goal: 让学生按合同要求正式通知、约定验房时间，并问清清洁要求
scenarios.opener: I'll need that in writing, thirty days out.
keyPhrases: When can we do the walkthrough?
What condition does it need to be in?

scenarios.title: 找人转租
scenarios.aiRole: 一位有兴趣但很谨慎的看房人
scenarios.setting: 学生要出国半年，想把房子转租出去
scenarios.goal: 让学生介绍房子优点、如实回答缺点，并说清转租的条件

keyPhrases: The landlord has to approve it
To be honest, the kitchen is small

scenarios.title: 买租房保险
scenarios.aiRole: 一位保险经纪
scenarios.setting: 学生要买一份租房保险
scenarios.goal: 让学生问清保障范围、保额和免赔额，并选定一个方案
scenarios.opener: What's the approximate value of your belongings?
keyPhrases: How do I file a claim?

scenarios.title: 面对不合理的驱逐
scenarios.aiRole: 一位威胁要赶人的房东
scenarios.setting: 房东以不合理的理由要求学生一周内搬走
scenarios.goal: 让学生冷静援引合同和法律、拒绝不合理要求，并说明下一步
scenarios.opener: I want you out by the end of the week.
keyPhrases: That's not what the lease says
You have to give proper notice

scenarios.title: 入职第一天
scenarios.aiRole: 一位带新人的同事
scenarios.setting: 学生第一天上班，被带着认识环境
scenarios.goal: 让学生完成自我介绍、问出几个实际问题（打卡、午饭、工位）
scenarios.opener: Welcome aboard! Let me show you around.
keyPhrases: What time do people take lunch?
Who should I ask if I'm stuck?

scenarios.title: 口头交代一封邮件
scenarios.aiRole: 一位帮你确认措辞的同事
scenarios.setting: 学生要发一封请求协助的邮件，先和同事对一下
scenarios.goal: 让学生说清邮件目的和要点，并采纳一条修改建议
scenarios.opener: What are you trying to get across?
keyPhrases: I need to ask them for...

scenarios.title: 会议上发言
scenarios.aiRole: 一位主持会议的经理
scenarios.setting: 学生在会上想提出一个想法但插不上话
scenarios.goal: 让学生找到时机插话、清楚表达想法，并回应一个追问
scenarios.opener: Anything else before we wrap up?

scenarios.title: 向同事求助
scenarios.aiRole: 一位乐于帮忙但很忙的同事
scenarios.setting: 学生被一个任务卡住了两小时
scenarios.goal: 让学生说清已经试过什么、具体卡在哪，并约定一个不打扰对方的时间

keyPhrases: Could you point me in the right direction?

scenarios.title: 请病假

scenarios.aiRole: 一位经理
scenarios.setting: 学生生病了要请一天假
scenarios.goal: 让学生通知请假、说明手头工作怎么办，并给出预计返岗时间

scenarios.title: 约同事吃午饭

keyPhrases: There's a place around the corner
How long have you been here?
What do you usually do on weekends?

scenarios.title: 同事间的闲聊

scenarios.goal: 让学生自然地接话并把对话延续三轮以上，不冷场

scenarios.title: 把任务问清楚

scenarios.setting: 上级丢过来一个说不清楚的任务

scenarios.title: 汇报进度

Happy to go with your call
